info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Weather Alerts Settings-v3-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Settings Retrieval API allows users to access and view the configured weather alert settings for their account. This API serves as a critical resource for applications requiring real-time weather alert data, enabling developers to integrate alert settings management into their services. Typical consumers include meteorological services, mobile applications, and any platforms looking to enhance user awareness of weather conditions. This endpoint facilitates efficient retrieval of settings, empowering users to stay informed and act accordingly based on severe weather conditions.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current alert settings configured in the system. It provides details on the alerts the user can manage and customize.

requestBody.description: This request body retrieves the current settings for alerts. It specifies parameters that dictate what details about the alerts are being modified or accessed.

ListWeatherAlertsSettingsRequest.description: Represents the request body for the Alerts Settings GET operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful or not.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number related to the operation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the alert settings.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation result.

ListWeatherAlertsSettingsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET operation on alerts settings.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information about the audit details associated with the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A value of 0 indicates that the processing time could not be measured or was negligible.
